prompt: Which U.S. airline had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year of 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Air Travel Consumer Report?
answer: **JetBlue Airways** had the highest percentage of delayed flights in 2024. Its on-time arrival rate was **68.3%**, meaning approximately **31.7% of its flights were delayed**, according to the DOT’s Air Travel Consumer Report.
